###  What Is The Invicta Customer Service Number? 
Invicta customer service phone number is 954-921-2444. To call toll-free, dial 800-327-7682. Call Invicta customer support to get information about new arrivals and current available products, address questions about payment methods and delivery, get help with your order, and more. If you choose to contact the company via phone, please note that Monday is the busiest day with the longest wait time.
###  What Is The Invicta Email Address? 
Those who prefer written communication can reach out to Invicta via email. Invicta email address is invicta@iwscwatchrepair.com. To address general inquiries about the company, its products and services, send an email to info@invictawatch.com. The corporate sales department can be reached at sales@invictawatch.com.  
If you are looking for a job and would like to learn more about available career opportunities at the company, send your CV and job inquiries to jobs@invictawatch.com.
###  What Is The Invicta Corporate Office Address? 
Invicta headquarters is based in Florida. To contact the company via regular mail, to send documents, or any other correspondence, send your letters to the following Invicta address: 1 Invicta Way (3069 Taft St), Hollywood, Florida 33021, United States.
###  What Are The Invicta Support Hours Of Operation? 
Invicta customer service department is available Monday through Friday from 9 am to 4 pm PT. All consumer issues and inquiries are addressed within these business hours. During the holidays (Christmas, Independence Day, etc.) the operation hours may change.
###  How Can I Contact Invicta Via The Website? 
To submit an inquiry via Invicta website, scroll down the page and follow the “Contact” hyperlink. Then, fill out a short online form and click the “Submit” button. Soon after you send the message, one of the customer care agents will be in touch to assist you. Alternatively, you can reach out to the company via phone, email or social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, or YouTube).

## Frequently Asked Questions
###  How does PissedConsumer verify the accuracy and safety of contact information and phone numbers? 
PissedConsumer collects contact information primarily from official companies' channels, such as corporate websites and verified social media pages. Data from these sources is usually added without additional individual verification. If the contact comes from a secondary source, the PissedConsumer team verifies it against fraud and abuse reporting databases and conducts additional validation, including test calls, prior to publication. We also perform regular, selective spot checks and respond promptly to users' reports and requests to ensure the data is current, accurate, and secure.
###  How can I be sure these phone numbers are not scams or fraud lines? 
Phone numbers published on the official company website or its verified social media pages are considered authoritative at the time of the information collection. For contacts obtained from secondary sources, the PissedConsumer team conducts risk screening and additional validation before publication. We also promptly verify any phone numbers reported by the community and remove records that fail to pass verification or update their status.   
Contact information posted by users in comments and reviews is not verified by PissedConsumer and may be unreliable. We suggest relying primarily on the official contact details in the company profile and reporting any suspicious content through the reporting form for your safety. Also, note that the phone numbers shown in the ads are not associated with the company's official contact details. 
###  How often are these contact details checked and updated? 
The PissedConsumer team always maintains the accuracy of contact details and reverifies phone numbers and email addresses of the companies. We prioritize reverifying data reported by our users and data that shows warning signs. Besides, we quickly check phone numbers that seem disconnected, reassigned, or compromised. Our team also promptly updates and cross-checks data when verified company representatives report discrepancies in contact details. However, please note that we do not guarantee fixed intervals for revalidating every listing. 
###  What is the primary source for the contact information listed here? 
The primary sources for the contact information listed here are official company sources, such as their corporate website and verified social media profiles. The PissedConsumer team also uses direct data from the company or its authorized representatives when possible. 
###  Is unverified contact information published on PissedConsumer? 
PissedConsumer does not publish unverified contact information. We mainly rely on official company websites and their verified social media pages. They are regarded as authoritative sources. Our team cross-checks every update and conducts thorough risk screening. Whenever possible, we use contact details that companies or their official representatives give us. If so, everything stays current. If customers or businesses report incorrect contact information, we start a validation process and cross-reference the details with trusted third-party sources. 
###  How can I report incorrect contact information displayed on a page? 
Names, phone numbers, and email addresses listed on this page are provided for informational purposes and to help you contact the company. We check and believe this information is accurate, but because details can change, PissedConsumer.com does not guarantee notice any incorrect contact details, you can report them by filling out this [form](https://www.pissedconsumer.com/contact/general-inquiry.html).

# News & Blog
### A day in the life of… our Technical Manager
#### Our staff are at the very core of our success, so we’ve decided to celebrate them in this special ‘A day in the life of…’ Q&A blog post series.
First up to spill the beans on what life’s like here at Invicta is **our Technical Manager, Terry Ryan.**
Terry used to be our Technical Customer Support specialist, but over the last 18 months, his role’s developed as the business and technical department has grown, resulting in Terry becoming our Technical Manager. Take it away Terry…
[![technical manager invicta](https://invicta-attachments.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2018/10/thumbnail-terry-ryan.jpg)](https://invicta-attachments.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2018/10/thumbnail-terry-ryan.jpg)
#### Q. What time does your day usually start?
A. Around 6am, which is so much easier to accept in the summer than in the winter.
#### Q. What sort of time do you start work?
A. If I’m in the office, I’ll be sat at my desk at 7:30am or in the warehouse measuring or checking forks or forklift attachments.
If I’m out visiting customers, then I’m on the road early to beat the traffic queues and get to the first site meeting. I’m generally our and about two to three days a week, so the motorway network can either be a friend or foe – sat in traffic jams is one of the downsides to my role.
#### Q. How does your day usually begin?
A. First things first (if I’m not off-site) – with a coffee in the office! Then on to the emails, quotations and designing bespoke forklift attachments.
#### Q. What does your role involve?
A. The technical department gets involved with specifying the correct piece of equipment for the requirement, so I’m either working alongside my colleagues in sales to identify standard equipment, or working with the customer to determine the answer to the problem, and then the design and costing of the new forklift attachment.
#### Q. What do you most enjoy about your job and why?
A. The challenge it presents – the cliché of ‘every day is different’ has never rung truer than here at Invicta.
Keeping in touch with some very good customers, friends and acquaintances I’ve made over 35 years in the industry is always worthwhile, and the buzz of solving a problem and seeing the equipment in action never gets any less exciting.
#### Q. What do you find most challenging and why?
A. Identifying the most cost-effective and workable solution for the customer – whether that’s supplying a bespoke piece of equipment specifically for the application or modifying an existing attachment to better meet the requirement and keep things simple.
#### Q. What’s been your biggest work-related achievement so far and why?
A. Other than individual designs of attachments that are now out working, the biggest achievement is very general and involves being a part of the growth of the business and seeing the headcount grow from around seven to 17 people in the space of just four years. Exciting times lie ahead, that’s for sure!
#### Q. What advice would you give to aspiring technical managers?
A. Learn from everyone around you and understand that every day is a school day.
#### Q. What time do you usually clock off?
A. The office closes at 5pm each day, so if I’m in the office, I’ll be away shortly after that once I’ve caught up on all of my messages/voicemails/emails. If I’m out on the road, the end of the day normally ends like it started – sat in traffic.
#### Q. What’s the last task you tend to do each day?
A. With modern technology being as it is, I’ll check emails and sort out the priorities for the next day or ping details to my colleagues for them to action.
**We hope you’ve found this Q &A with Terry enjoyable and useful. Keep your eyes peeled for our next ‘A Day in the life of…’ blog post when another one of our employees reveals all about their role at Invicta. In the meantime, if you’d like to find out more about our bespoke forklift attachment capabilities or discuss your forklift attachment requirements with us, contact us on 0113 277 1222 or sales@invicta-attachments.co.uk.**

A long history of expertise
#  The jewel of the French foundry 
##  French and European leader in the wood heating market 
Established in Donchery in the Champagne-Ardenne region since 1924, Invicta relies on a high-performance production facility.
Invicta’s foundry and enamelling facilities enable it to offer a wide range of products, and to bring new innovations in design and technology every year.
Invicta’s creativity and technological innovations perpetuate and renew the world of foundry. 308 employees contribute to Invicta’s success, an alchemy of know-how and talent.
Today, its know-how extends to sectors as diverse as wood-burning heating, barbecues, culinary pottery, decoration, furniture…
Invicta controls 100% of the manufacturing process in-house: design office, accredited testing laboratory, foundry, enameling, surface treatments, marketing and distribution.
The cast-iron stoves, fireplaces and inserts manufactured by Invicta have the Origine France Garantie label. This certification is clear, simple and easily identifiable by the consumer.
It guarantees the product’s French origin and highlights the expertise of Invicta’s foundry and enameling plants.
![Logo Origine France Garantie Invicta](https://www.invicta.fr/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/OFG-01-764x1080-1.png) ![Logo certifications Invicta Veritas ISO 9011 - ISO 14001 - ISO 45001](https://www.invicta.fr/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/BV_Certification_ANNEE_9001-14001-45001.jpg)
##  The Invicta foundry 
Specializing in the production of lamellar graphite cast iron (GL cast iron) parts, the Invicta foundry manufactures over 110,000 wood-burning appliances, casseroles, furniture bases and barbecues every year.
ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certified, the Invicta foundry is committed to quality and respect for the environment.
The Invicta foundry has state-of-the-art equipment enabling it to regularly develop new castings for Invicta or other subcontract customers
  * Rapid prototyping (tool-free counter-molding, 3D printing)
  * Several molding lines, including a DISAMATIC 280
  * Machining, assembly, finishing lines (dip painting, enameling)

##  Enamel plant 
A metal coating technique, enameling has been used since Antiquity to adorn objets d’art. Today, Invicta’s enameling teams master this tradition with virtuosity to color everyday objects:
  * spray application of enamel pigments and kiln firing
  * enameling of wood-burning stoves, casseroles, cookware and decorative items
  * wide range of colors: traditional black, ruby red, caviar gray, france blue, flamed orange, pastel or acidic…

# Privacy policy
_Last update: October 30, 2024_
This privacy policy applies to the processing of personal data carried out by INVICTA GROUP, as data controller (hereinafter “**Invicta** “) via its website accessible at the following address: www.invicta.fr.
Invicta takes care when processing your personal data to comply with applicable regulations including the French Data Protection Act of January 6, 1978 as amended and European Regulation No. 2016/679/EU of April 26, 2016 (RGPD).
The purpose of this privacy policy is to inform you of the processing operations carried out on your personal data and of your rights.
We invite you to consult this privacy policy regularly in order to be informed of any changes that may be made to it. You will be informed of any substantial changes.
**1. Identity and contact details of the data controller**
Your personal information is collected and processed by : **INVICTA GROUP** ; Zone Industrielle Lieudit La Gravette, 08350 DONCHERY ; rgpd@invictagroup.zendesk.com
**2. Collection of personal data by Invicta**
_2.1. Categories of personal data_
Invicta is likely to process your personal data, in particular your identification data (_surname, first name, e-mail, postal address, telephone number and invoice_), personal data collected via the free text of the various forms (_contact forms, breakdown and/or repair request forms_), but also photographs illustrating the installation of your products in the event of a breakdown and/or repair request.
Invicta also processes data on the devices you use to access the website, such as data from cookies.
_2.2. Methods of collecting personal data_
Invicta may collect your personal data in various ways, including :
* When you browse the website ;
* During your exchanges, of any nature whatsoever, via the forms present on the website, by e-mail, by post, by telephone, on social networks ;
* When you subscribe to our newsletter;
* If you are one of our suppliers or service providers.
This personal data may be collected directly by a positive act on your part _(e.g. via a contact form, quotation request, product registration, commissioning or maintenance, troubleshooting or repair request)_ or automatically by our systems, by depositing cookies on your terminal.
_2.3. Mandatory information and necessity of personal data collection_
The provision of certain information is compulsory to enable Invicta to process your various requests made on its website via the forms. If you do not provide the required information in the forms on the website, Invicta may not be able to process your request.
Fields in a form that are not marked as mandatory are left to your discretion. It is up to you to decide whether or not to fill them in.
**3. Purposes and legal basis of the processing of your personal data**
Invicta only processes your personal data if this is necessary for the purposes for which it was collected. Invicta will only process your personal data if there is a legal basis for doing so.

**4. Retention periods for personal data**
Invicta keeps your personal data in a form that allows you to be identified for as long as is necessary for the purposes for which it was collected. Invicta then archives it, unless you exercise your right to delete your data or if a longer retention period is authorized or imposed by virtue of a legal or regulatory provision.
The criteria used to determine retention periods are as follows:
* The period during which we maintain a relationship with you (for example, during the entire commercial transaction for the purchase of an Invicta product, including the warranty period of 2 to 5 years depending on the product);
* Existence of a legal or regulatory obligation to which Invicta is subject.
**5. Recipients of personal data**
Access to your personal data is strictly limited. Invicta may, however, transmit your personal data to certain third parties:
*** Invicta staff,** who are subject to confidentiality obligations, in charge of the above-mentioned processing operations in the performance of their duties;
*** to external service providers** , such as suppliers, installers and resellers, in connection with the processing operations identified on behalf of Invicta.
*** to other third parties** if such disclosure is required by law, regulation or court order, or to respond to claims or protect the security of your personal data.
In the event of transfer outside the European Union, Invicta undertakes to guarantee a sufficient level of protection and to take all appropriate precautions.
**6. Exercising rights to personal data**
Pursuant to the French Data Protection Act of January 6, 1978, as amended, and European Regulation No. 2016/679/EU of April 26, 2016, you have the following rights with regard to your personal data:
*** right of access** to know exactly what data is processed by Invicta ;

*** right of portability** if you wish to recover your personal data or have them recovered by a third party;
*** right of restriction** if you wish to suspend the processing of your personal data:
*** the right to object** if you no longer wish your personal data to be processed by Invicta;
*** the right to define** directives concerning the fate of your personal data after your death.
Depending on the choices you make when you first contact us by email or telephone, you can choose whether or not you wish to receive commercial or promotional offers electronically.
You have the right to object to the processing of your personal data for commercial prospecting purposes, including profiling, at any time and without giving any reason, and the right to withdraw any consent given to Invicta.
In the event of Invicta collecting telephone data, you have the right, pursuant to article L. 223-2 of the French Consumer Code, to register on the _Bloctel_ list of telephone companies.

Why this product?
Air-tight certified device
The new European standard EN 16510 for solid-fuel heating appliances clarifies the situation by requiring a leak test to certify air-tight appliances. Under this standard, the user manual or technical data sheet for wood stoves specifies the appliance type. The CC50 appliance type primarily corresponds to air-tight pellet stoves.
Airtight unit RT2012 / RE2020 compatible
Ideal for low-energy consumption construction (BBC), RT2012 or RE2020. The unit is equipped with a central fresh air input on a connection nozzle:  
* no air intake in the room,  
* direct connection possible to crawl space or external air intake.
Can be installed facing front (zone 3 – suction)
Also called the suction exhaust, zone 3 installation does not require an existing chimney flue. The smoke exhaust tubing horizontally to the front. This installation configuration requires a concentric flue and professional advice. Only sealed wood pellet stoves certified by CSTB can be installed in zone 3.
Combustion Control Kit (CCK)
The KCC is used to adapt the unit to the specifications for wood pellets, such as: the type of installation, altitude, the type of soiling caused by the burner and heat exchanger, to ensure more efficient and better performance over time and to reduce maintenance.
Extended warranty 1 year
For pellet appliances, the 1-year warranty extension is conditional on the is conditional on the product being registered online.
Hourly schedule
*DAY: The unit has 2 daily programs so it can turn on and off twice per day  
*WEEK: the unit has 4 weekly programs so that you can program it to turn on and off 4 times per day, every day of the week.  
*WEEKEND: the unit has 2 programs for the weekend (Saturday, Sunday), which enable it to turn on and off twice per day
Integrated concentric (coaxial) top outlet 80/130
The concentric connection system offers a number of aesthetic and technical advantages:  
* Optimum stove operation: the concentric flue provides both flue gas evacuation and fresh air supply.  
* Simplified installation, suitable for Zone 2 or 3 installations.  
* Space-saving.
Integrated WiFi
Pellet stove equipped with WiFi as standard to control the device remotely from a smartphone or tablet and via a dedicated application.
Optional external thermostat control (not included)
Air distribution connection lines are available as an option. Reference P690080: kit 2 connection lines & screws.
Power (5) or room temperature control
* Power settings: 5 pre-programmed power settings managed automatically.  
* Setpoint temperature setting: you choose the desired room temperature. It is measured by a wired sensor. The pellet stove regulates its power to reach and maintain the required value.
Standby
Standby is a backup feature of the device. The unit turns off if the room temperature is 3°C higher than the temperature set for over 60 seconds. The unit turns on again when the room temperature drops 1°C below the temperature set.
Ventilator for hot air output
A tangential forced convection ventilator is used. It distributes the hot air inside the room.

¿Por qué este producto?
### Descubre en vídeo
![YouTube video](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/oaGu5m-LZJ4/hqdefault.jpg)
Conectable
Se puede conectar directamente la entrada de aire fresco a la estufa, ya sea desde el exterior o desde un vacío sanitario.
Cristal limpio
El sistema cristal limpio permite ralentizar el ritmo al que se ensucia el cristal. Una entrada de aire situada en la parte superior del cristal crea una corriente protectora. El aire precalentado se propulsa sobre la superficie del cristal. Inicia la combustión de los gases y de los materiales volátiles, protegiendo así el cristal del humo y de los depósitos de hollín.
Cuidado diseño
* Diseño y mango ergonómico pensado para un cierre flexible y sin juego,  
* Almohadillas de plástico debajo de los pies para proteger el piso,  
* Amortiguador de aire primario giratorio para una mejor precisión de ajuste de velocidad,  
* Cajón cenicero extraíble,  
* Bisagra de puerta de hierro fundido de una sola pieza para apertura de 90° y mayor precisión.
Garantía de origen francés
La etiqueta Origine France Garantie (Origen Francia garantizado) es la única certificación que acredita que un producto ha sido fabricado en Francia. Esta etiqueta, certificada por un organismo independiente, se otorga tras una auditoría. (Bureau Veritas n. º 7208672). Los productos OFG están fabricados en Francia, en las plantas de producción de Invicta Group.
Garantia extendida 3 años
Para productos de leña, la extensión de garantía gratuita de 3 años está condicionada a que el producto se registre en línea.
Sistema de post-combustión
Inyección de aire precalentado en la cámara de combustión. La entrada de aire suplementaria de la parte trasera permite destruir los hidrocarburos a alta temperatura. La combustión es completa y se reduce la contaminación.

¿Por qué este producto?
### Descubre en vídeo
![YouTube video](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/imycIbAkjUQ/hqdefault.jpg)
Conectable
Se puede conectar directamente la entrada de aire fresco a la estufa, ya sea desde el exterior o desde un vacío sanitario.
Cristal limpio
El sistema cristal limpio permite ralentizar el ritmo al que se ensucia el cristal. Una entrada de aire situada en la parte superior del cristal crea una corriente protectora. El aire precalentado se propulsa sobre la superficie del cristal. Inicia la combustión de los gases y de los materiales volátiles, protegiendo así el cristal del humo y de los depósitos de hollín.
Cuidado diseño
* Diseño y mango ergonómico pensado para un cierre flexible y sin juego,  
* Almohadillas de plástico debajo de los pies para proteger el piso,  
* Amortiguador de aire primario giratorio para una mejor precisión de ajuste de velocidad,  
* Cajón cenicero extraíble,  
* Bisagra de puerta de hierro fundido de una sola pieza para apertura de 90° y mayor precisión.
Garantía de origen francés
La etiqueta Origine France Garantie (Origen Francia garantizado) es la única certificación que acredita que un producto ha sido fabricado en Francia. Esta etiqueta, certificada por un organismo independiente, se otorga tras una auditoría. (Bureau Veritas n. º 7208672). Los productos OFG están fabricados en Francia, en las plantas de producción de Invicta Group.
Garantia extendida 3 años
Para productos de leña, la extensión de garantía gratuita de 3 años está condicionada a que el producto se registre en línea.
Sistema de post-combustión
Inyección de aire precalentado en la cámara de combustión. La entrada de aire suplementaria de la parte trasera permite destruir los hidrocarburos a alta temperatura. La combustión es completa y se reduce la contaminación.

¿Por qué este producto?
### Descubre en vídeo
![YouTube video](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/V9lNk_Bgd0w/hqdefault.jpg)
Conectable
Se puede conectar directamente la entrada de aire fresco a la estufa, ya sea desde el exterior o desde un vacío sanitario.
Cristal limpio
El sistema cristal limpio permite ralentizar el ritmo al que se ensucia el cristal. Una entrada de aire situada en la parte superior del cristal crea una corriente protectora. El aire precalentado se propulsa sobre la superficie del cristal. Inicia la combustión de los gases y de los materiales volátiles, protegiendo así el cristal del humo y de los depósitos de hollín.
Cuidado diseño
* Diseño y mango ergonómico pensado para un cierre flexible y sin juego,  
* Almohadillas de plástico debajo de los pies para proteger el piso,  
* Amortiguador de aire primario giratorio para una mejor precisión de ajuste de velocidad,  
* Cajón cenicero extraíble,  
* Bisagra de puerta de hierro fundido de una sola pieza para apertura de 90° y mayor precisión.
diseño unico
Diseño único para realzar cualquier decoración.
Garantía de origen francés
La etiqueta Origine France Garantie (Origen Francia garantizado) es la única certificación que acredita que un producto ha sido fabricado en Francia. Esta etiqueta, certificada por un organismo independiente, se otorga tras una auditoría. (Bureau Veritas n. º 7208672). Los productos OFG están fabricados en Francia, en las plantas de producción de Invicta Group.
Garantia extendida 3 años
Para productos de leña, la extensión de garantía gratuita de 3 años está condicionada a que el producto se registre en línea.
Sistema de post-combustión
Inyección de aire precalentado en la cámara de combustión. La entrada de aire suplementaria de la parte trasera permite destruir los hidrocarburos a alta temperatura. La combustión es completa y se reduce la contaminación.

¿Por qué este producto?
Aire secundario regulable
El aire secundario protege el cristal del humo y de los depósitos de hollín. Garantiza la combustión de los materiales volátiles. El flujo de aire secundario ajustable permite adaptar el funcionamiento del aparato a condiciones de tiro demasiado elevadas.
Conectable
Se puede conectar directamente la entrada de aire fresco a la estufa, ya sea desde el exterior o desde un vacío sanitario.
Cristal limpio
El sistema cristal limpio permite ralentizar el ritmo al que se ensucia el cristal. Una entrada de aire situada en la parte superior del cristal crea una corriente protectora. El aire precalentado se propulsa sobre la superficie del cristal. Inicia la combustión de los gases y de los materiales volátiles, protegiendo así el cristal del humo y de los depósitos de hollín.
Garantía de origen francés
La etiqueta Origine France Garantie (Origen Francia garantizado) es la única certificación que acredita que un producto ha sido fabricado en Francia. Esta etiqueta, certificada por un organismo independiente, se otorga tras una auditoría. (Bureau Veritas n. º 7208672). Los productos OFG están fabricados en Francia, en las plantas de producción de Invicta Group.
Garantia extendida 3 años
Para productos de leña, la extensión de garantía gratuita de 3 años está condicionada a que el producto se registre en línea.
Revestimiento de vermiculita
Revestimiento de la cámara de combustión con piezas desmontables de vermiculita (deflector, placa de hierro fundido, laterales y solera). Las propiedades térmicas de la vermiculita mejoran la calidad de la combustión y el rendimiento del aparato.
Sistema de post-combustión
Inyección de aire precalentado en la cámara de combustión. La entrada de aire suplementaria de la parte trasera permite destruir los hidrocarburos a alta temperatura. La combustión es completa y se reduce la contaminación.

¿Por qué este producto?
Aire secundario regulable
El aire secundario protege el cristal del humo y de los depósitos de hollín. Garantiza la combustión de los materiales volátiles. El flujo de aire secundario ajustable permite adaptar el funcionamiento del aparato a condiciones de tiro demasiado elevadas.
Conectable
Se puede conectar directamente la entrada de aire fresco a la estufa, ya sea desde el exterior o desde un vacío sanitario.
Cristal limpio
El sistema cristal limpio permite ralentizar el ritmo al que se ensucia el cristal. Una entrada de aire situada en la parte superior del cristal crea una corriente protectora. El aire precalentado se propulsa sobre la superficie del cristal. Inicia la combustión de los gases y de los materiales volátiles, protegiendo así el cristal del humo y de los depósitos de hollín.
Garantía de origen francés
La etiqueta Origine France Garantie (Origen Francia garantizado) es la única certificación que acredita que un producto ha sido fabricado en Francia. Esta etiqueta, certificada por un organismo independiente, se otorga tras una auditoría. (Bureau Veritas n. º 7208672). Los productos OFG están fabricados en Francia, en las plantas de producción de Invicta Group.
Garantia extendida 3 años
Para productos de leña, la extensión de garantía gratuita de 3 años está condicionada a que el producto se registre en línea.
Revestimiento de vermiculita
Revestimiento de la cámara de combustión con piezas desmontables de vermiculita (deflector, placa de hierro fundido, laterales y solera). Las propiedades térmicas de la vermiculita mejoran la calidad de la combustión y el rendimiento del aparato.
Sistema de post-combustión
Inyección de aire precalentado en la cámara de combustión. La entrada de aire suplementaria de la parte trasera permite destruir los hidrocarburos a alta temperatura. La combustión es completa y se reduce la contaminación.

Experiencia histórica
#  Pepita de la fundición francesa 
##  Líder en Francia y Europa en el mercado de la calefacción de leña 
Establecida en Donchery, en la región de Champaña-Ardenas, desde 1924, Invicta cuenta con instalaciones de producción de alto rendimiento.
Su fundición y su planta de esmaltado le permiten ofrecer una amplia gama de productos e introducir cada año nuevas innovaciones en diseño y tecnología.
La creatividad y las innovaciones tecnológicas de Invicta perpetúan y renuevan el mundo de la fundición. 308 empleados contribuyen al éxito de Invicta, una alquimia de conocimientos técnicos y talento.
En la actualidad, su experiencia se extiende a sectores tan diversos como: calefacción de leña, barbacoas, cerámica culinaria, decoración, muebles, etc.
Invicta controla internamente el 100% del proceso de fabricación: oficina de proyectos, laboratorio de pruebas acreditado, fundición, esmaltado, tratamientos de superficie, comercialización y distribución.
Las estufas, chimeneas e inserts de hierro fundido fabricados por Invicta llevan la etiqueta Origine France Garantie. Esta certificación es clara, sencilla y fácil de identificar para los consumidores.
Garantiza el origen francés del producto y pone de relieve el saber hacer de la fundición y la esmaltería Invicta.
![Logo Origine France Garantie Invicta](https://www.invicta.fr/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/OFG-01-764x1080-1.png) ![Logo certifications Invicta Veritas ISO 9011 - ISO 14001 - ISO 45001](https://www.invicta.fr/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/BV_Certification_ANNEE_9001-14001-45001.jpg)
##  La fundición Invicta 
Especializada en la producción de fundición de grafito laminar (fundición GL), la fundición Invicta fabrica cada año más de 110.000 aparatos de leña, cacerolas, bases de muebles y barbacoas.
Certificada ISO 9001, ISO 14001 e ISO 45001, la fundición Invicta está comprometida con la calidad y el respeto del medio ambiente.
La fundición de Invicta dispone de equipos de última generación que le permiten desarrollar regularmente nuevas piezas de fundición para Invicta u otros clientes subcontratados
  * Prototipado rápido (contramoldeo sin herramientas, impresión 3D)
  * Varias líneas de moldeo, incluida una DISAMATIC 280
  * Líneas de mecanizado, montaje y acabado (pintura endurecida, esmaltado)

##  Esmalte Invicta 
El esmaltado es una técnica de recubrimiento del metal que se utiliza desde la Antigüedad para decorar obras de arte. Hoy en día, los equipos de esmaltado de Invicta dominan esta tradición con virtuosismo, coloreando objetos cotidianos:
  * aplicación de pigmentos de esmalte por pulverización y cocción en horno
  * esmaltado de estufas de leña, cacerolas, utensilios de cocina y objetos de decoración
  * una amplia gama de colores: negro tradicional, rojo rubí, gris caviar, azul francia, naranja flameado, pastel o ácido…

About us 
###  Invicta Sourcing 
Your Premier Sourcing and Manufacturing Partner  
Based in Uttara, Dhaka, Bangladesh, Invicta Sourcing is a leading Garment Buying House and Sourcing Agent with over 15 years of expertise in the global apparel industry. Specializing in woven, knit, and sweater manufacturing, we are your one-stop destination for a wide range of products, including clothing, headwear, patches, socks, keychains, lanyards, wristbands, posters, flags, scarves, bags, baby bibs, backpacks, phone cases, plush toys, and much more.
As a trusted partner, we take great pride in managing the entire production and export process for our clients. From initial sourcing and factory placement to final shipment, our comprehensive services include:
  * Product Sourcing & Factory Placement: We connect you with the best factories, ensuring quality and reliability at every stage.
  * Production Planning & Follow-Up: Our team handles everything from planning to execution, maintaining close oversight throughout the production process.
  * Regular Communication & Status Updates: We keep you informed with daily updates on production progress and ensure timely responses to any concerns.
  * Inspection & Quality Control: We conduct both inline and final inspections to ensure that every product meets your exact specifications.
  * Shipment Coordination: We manage the entire shipment process, including delivery schedules and shipping documentation, ensuring smooth and timely delivery.


Our vertically integrated approach, combined with a dedicated and proactive team of merchandising, technical, and QC professionals, allows us to operate efficiently and with great speed. We are deeply committed to delivering the highest quality products at competitive prices, all while ensuring on-time shipments and maintaining strong, long-term business relationships.
At Invicta Sourcing, we understand that success in business is built on trust, reliability, and a commitment to quality. We are committed to exceeding your expectations and continuously growing to meet the evolving needs of our clients worldwide.

Invicta Solutions Group is an IT services and consulting firm based in Franklin, Tennessee. It functions as a resource hub for security leaders, offering processes, platforms, and personnel to simplify technology security across complex business environments.

Why this product?
Air-tight certified device
The new European standard EN 16510 for solid-fuel heating appliances clarifies the situation by requiring a leak test to certify air-tight appliances. Under this standard, the user manual or technical data sheet for wood stoves specifies the appliance type. The CC50 appliance type primarily corresponds to air-tight pellet stoves.
Airtight unit RT2012 / RE2020 compatible
Ideal for low-energy consumption construction (BBC), RT2012 or RE2020. The unit is equipped with a central fresh air input on a connection nozzle:  
* no air intake in the room,  
* direct connection possible to crawl space or external air intake.
Can be installed facing front (zone 3 – suction)
Also called the suction exhaust, zone 3 installation does not require an existing chimney flue. The smoke exhaust tubing horizontally to the front. This installation configuration requires a concentric flue and professional advice. Only sealed wood pellet stoves certified by CSTB can be installed in zone 3.
Combustion Control Kit (CCK)
The KCC is used to adapt the unit to the specifications for wood pellets, such as: the type of installation, altitude, the type of soiling caused by the burner and heat exchanger, to ensure more efficient and better performance over time and to reduce maintenance.
Connectable
Can be connected directly from the wood stove’s fresh air intake to the outside or a crawlspace.
Extended warranty 1 year
For pellet appliances, the 1-year warranty extension is conditional on the is conditional on the product being registered online.
Hourly schedule
*DAY: The unit has 2 daily programs so it can turn on and off twice per day  
*WEEK: the unit has 4 weekly programs so that you can program it to turn on and off 4 times per day, every day of the week.  
*WEEKEND: the unit has 2 programs for the weekend (Saturday, Sunday), which enable it to turn on and off twice per day
Integrated WiFi
Pellet stove equipped with WiFi as standard to control the device remotely from a smartphone or tablet and via a dedicated application.
Optional external thermostat control (not included)
Air distribution connection lines are available as an option. Reference P690080: kit 2 connection lines & screws.
Power (5) or room temperature control
* Power settings: 5 pre-programmed power settings managed automatically.  
* Setpoint temperature setting: you choose the desired room temperature. It is measured by a wired sensor. The pellet stove regulates its power to reach and maintain the required value.
Standby
Standby is a backup feature of the device. The unit turns off if the room temperature is 3°C higher than the temperature set for over 60 seconds. The unit turns on again when the room temperature drops 1°C below the temperature set.
Ventilator for hot air output
A tangential forced convection ventilator is used. It distributes the hot air inside the room.

Why this product?
Air-tight certified device
The new European standard EN 16510 for solid-fuel heating appliances clarifies the situation by requiring a leak test to certify air-tight appliances. Under this standard, the user manual or technical data sheet for wood stoves specifies the appliance type. The CC50 appliance type primarily corresponds to air-tight pellet stoves.
Airtight unit RT2012 / RE2020 compatible
Ideal for low-energy consumption construction (BBC), RT2012 or RE2020. The unit is equipped with a central fresh air input on a connection nozzle:  
* no air intake in the room,  
* direct connection possible to crawl space or external air intake.
Can be installed facing front (zone 3 – suction)
Also called the suction exhaust, zone 3 installation does not require an existing chimney flue. The smoke exhaust tubing horizontally to the front. This installation configuration requires a concentric flue and professional advice. Only sealed wood pellet stoves certified by CSTB can be installed in zone 3.
Combustion Control Kit (CCK)
The KCC is used to adapt the unit to the specifications for wood pellets, such as: the type of installation, altitude, the type of soiling caused by the burner and heat exchanger, to ensure more efficient and better performance over time and to reduce maintenance.
Connectable
Can be connected directly from the wood stove’s fresh air intake to the outside or a crawlspace.
Extended warranty 1 year
For pellet appliances, the 1-year warranty extension is conditional on the is conditional on the product being registered online.
Hourly schedule
*DAY: The unit has 2 daily programs so it can turn on and off twice per day  
*WEEK: the unit has 4 weekly programs so that you can program it to turn on and off 4 times per day, every day of the week.  
*WEEKEND: the unit has 2 programs for the weekend (Saturday, Sunday), which enable it to turn on and off twice per day
Integrated WiFi
Pellet stove equipped with WiFi as standard to control the device remotely from a smartphone or tablet and via a dedicated application.
Optional external thermostat control (not included)
Air distribution connection lines are available as an option. Reference P690080: kit 2 connection lines & screws.
Power (5) or room temperature control
* Power settings: 5 pre-programmed power settings managed automatically.  
* Setpoint temperature setting: you choose the desired room temperature. It is measured by a wired sensor. The pellet stove regulates its power to reach and maintain the required value.
Standby
Standby is a backup feature of the device. The unit turns off if the room temperature is 3°C higher than the temperature set for over 60 seconds. The unit turns on again when the room temperature drops 1°C below the temperature set.
Ventilator for hot air output
A tangential forced convection ventilator is used. It distributes the hot air inside the room.
